summary: @or-sdk/permissions preinstall executes obfuscated bundled payload under a downloaded Bun runtime
details: The package's preinstall script `node setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from GitHub into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it to execute the sibling file `math_init.js`, a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle shipped in the tarball. `setup.mjs` itself uses hex-mangled identifiers (e.g. `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and inline lookup indirection, and `math_init.js` opens with a large numeric constant table and a rotating-array string decoder (`WV8StW` over `n7gIxM`) characteristic of commercial JS obfuscators. Bun is not a Node dependency of a permissions SDK, and running the shipped payload under a freshly-fetched alternate runtime bypasses the Node-based tooling an installer would normally apply to inspect or sandbox lifecycle scripts. The install-time code path that fires on `npm install` therefore consists of an opaque, obfuscated, non-Node payload the installer cannot statically review, executed with the installer's user privileges on the host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
